meta.name: add-rtk
meta.description: Install rtk token-compression proxy into agent containers. Routes Bash tool calls through rtk for 60–90% token savings on dev commands (git, cargo, pytest, docker, kubectl, etc.).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在容器中安装 rtk 代理以压缩令牌，节省开发命令的令牌消耗
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用 AI 辅助开发且想减少令牌消耗
copy.tagline_en: Install rtk proxy in containers to compress tokens and save on dev commands
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use AI-assisted development and want to reduce token usage

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 在容器中执行任何 Bash 命令时，都会自动被 rtk 代理拦截并压缩令牌消耗，全程无需用户干预。
howto.when: 当 Claude 需要运行 Bash 命令（如 git、cargo、pytest 等）时自动触发。

say.text: 运行 git status 查看当前仓库状态。
say.note: 该命令会经 rtk 压缩令牌。

say.text: 执行 pytest 运行测试。
say.note: 测试输出会被 rtk 压缩。

say.text: 用 docker ps 查看容器列表。

howto.what_en: After installing add-rtk, every Bash command Claude runs in the container is automatically intercepted by the rtk proxy, which compresses token usage transparently.
howto.when_en: Triggers whenever Claude invokes a Bash tool for commands like git, cargo, pytest, etc.

say_en.text: Run git status to see the current repo state.
Run docker ps to list containers.
